result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would eliminate **scarcity as a driver of human conflict and suffering**. 

By this, I don't just mean ensuring everyone has enough food, water, and shelter—though that is foundational. I mean removing the deep-seated scarcity mindset—the fear that there is not enough to go around, whether "enough" means resources, love, power, or safety. 

If people and nations no longer felt a fundamental threat to their survival and well-being, the root cause of much of the world's worst behavior—greed, corruption, war, prejudice, and oppression—would wither away. 

In its place, humanity could operate from a baseline of abundance and trust. We would be free to focus our collective energy, creativity, and empathy on exploring the universe, solving grand scientific challenges, and helping every individual reach their full potential. 

If you had the power to change one thing, what would you choose?
